# sh-fpv-album-view

**Purpose:** Full-screen album with "{n} of {total}" and Connect Now.

**Switches:** Case.

**Taps:** swipe photos · pinch to zoom · Connect Now · close.

Full profile view (migration, not yet core) · 2 variants · [Open in Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/l1SuD1Q1l8QXGvtomszGYW/Shaadi-DNA?node-id=2877-20019) (node `2877:20019`)
